title: Business capabilities
subtitle: One contract for buttons, agents and workflows. Every call is authorized, idempotent, audited and emits business events.
forbidden: Your account cannot use the capability console. Ask an administrator for the example module permissions.

records.title: Example records
records.hint: Creating a record runs a business transaction and writes an outbox event in the same commit. The AI review then runs asynchronously.
records.created: Record #{{id}} created. Its event is queued for AI review.

knowledge_search.title: Knowledge search
knowledge_search.description: Search the workspace knowledge base for rules, configuration and uploaded documents.

dictionary_options.title: Dictionary options
dictionary_options.description: Read the published options of a business dictionary.

notification_inbox.title: My inbox
notification_inbox.description: Read the notifications delivered to your own account.

notification_send.title: Send announcement
notification_send.description: Send an in-app announcement, optionally by email, to people your role may reach.

example_record_list.title: List example records
example_record_list.description: Read the example business records of the current tenant.

example_record_create.title: Create example record
example_record_create.description: Create a record and emit example.record.created in the same transaction.

example_record_archive.title: Archive example record
example_record_archive.description: Archive a record. High risk: automation must obtain human confirmation.

example_record_get.title: Inspect own example record
example_record_get.description: Read a record you created and whether it is ready for review. Archived records are not ready.

demo.title: Workflow example test
demo.hint: Running creates a reference record. Archiving requires your confirmation.
demo.unavailable: This API does not yet provide orchestration. Update and restart the API.
demo.forbidden: Workflow run/read and example create/read/archive permissions are required.
demo.fullReady: The full test includes readiness checks and agent review using your configured model.
demo.modelRequired: The basic test needs no model. The full test also requires assistant permission and an enabled, configured agent model.
demo.approvalHint: Confirm the archive action below. The workflow continues after approval.
demo.completed: Test completed: the reference record finished the workflow and was archived.
demo.failed: The workflow did not finish. Service code: {{code}}. Check the invocation trace.
demo.cancelled: Run cancelled. Already committed records remain.
